interestingFact: India is the world's largest democracy and home to the Taj Mahal.
Japan has thousands of islands and is famous for Mount Fuji.
The Eiffel Tower was originally built for the 1889 World's Fair.
Brazil is home to a large part of the Amazon Rainforest.
Australia is home to unique animals like kangaroos and koalas.
Canada has the longest coastline in the world.
Italy is home to the ancient Roman Colosseum.
Egypt is famous for its ancient pyramids and the Great Sphinx.
The United States has 50 states and is home to many famous national parks.
The United Kingdom consists of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.
